title: Real Estate Referral Program: How to Get Buyers From Happy Clients
seoTitle: Real Estate Referral Program: Rewards, Rules, Tracking
excerpt: How to run a real estate referral program in India: who and when to ask, reward ideas, payout terms, RERA, tax and consent points, and how to track it.

faqs.question: What is a real estate referral program?
faqs.answer: A real estate referral program is a written promise that when someone sends you a buyer who books, you thank them with a reward agreed in advance, such as a payment credit, a gift or, for professionals, a commission. Clear terms and on-time rewards are what make it work.

faqs.question: Why do referrals work in real estate?
faqs.answer: Buying a home is a big, rare decision, so buyers trust people they know. In Nielsen's 2015 Global Trust in Advertising survey, 83% of online respondents said they trusted recommendations from people they know. Referred buyers also arrive with context, which usually means more serious conversations.

faqs.question: Who are the best people to ask for real estate referrals?
faqs.answer: Happy past buyers and residents, current buyers in under-construction projects, channel partners and brokers, local professionals such as chartered accountants and interior designers, and your own team's networks under clear rules. Past buyers after possession are usually the most trusted referrers.

faqs.question: When should I ask a buyer for a referral?
faqs.answer: When they are happiest: right after booking, when the home loan is approved or the agreement for sale is registered, at key handover, or after you solve a problem well. Keep the ask short and low-pressure, such as a WhatsApp message with your number.

faqs.question: What rewards work for a property referral program?
faqs.answer: A credit on remaining instalments or maintenance, a gift such as appliances or furniture vouchers, a benefit for the new buyer too, recognition for residents with their permission, or for channel partners and professionals a commission under a written agreement. Choose what you can deliver on time.

faqs.question: When should a referral reward be paid?
faqs.answer: Usually once the referred buyer's agreement for sale is registered, or after a set number of payments, so you do not pay for cancelled bookings. Then pay within a fixed number of days, every time, because a late or disputed reward turns a supporter into a critic.

faqs.question: Does someone who refers buyers need RERA registration?
faqs.answer: Possibly. Section 2(zm) of the RERA Act defines an agent as someone who acts in a sale for commission, and Section 9 requires agents to register. A one-off thank-you gift differs from regular referrals for a fee. Check the position with your state RERA authority or a lawyer.

faqs.question: Is TDS or GST charged on referral commission?
faqs.answer: Commission and brokerage payments are subject to TDS under India's income tax law above a yearly threshold, and generally attract GST when the provider is GST-registered. Rates and thresholds change, so confirm the current position with the Income Tax Department's portal or your chartered accountant.

faqs.question: How do I track real estate referrals?
faqs.answer: Add a referred-by field to every lead, ask every new lead how they heard about you, give referrers an easy way to share your number, update the referrer on progress, and review referrals, site visits, bookings and rewards paid every month.
